review.description: Run transcripts, diffs and visible polling retain their existing contract; the report page consumes shared journal invalidation and bounded report APIs.
review.implementation: Factory retains its existing snapshot/change polling. The new report component refreshes lists/details when the journal cursor changes; report evidence copies bounded referenced event ranges with explicit truncation. The notice hover selector corrects presentation only; transcript paging and polling transitions remain unchanged.
review.tests: Existing transcript/polling fixtures remain mapped; report browser assertions verify information, recovery and independent delivery displays. Live-host and soak gaps remain open. The existing narrow recovery fixture now deliberately places the pointer over the notice during its light/dark scan, then retains the technical transcript focus and message-draft assertions.
